acceptanceCriteria: For a new test linked to a legacy test (crosswalk or explicit reference), setup on each side is extracted from committed blobs into a normalised shape (entity kind, count per kind, explicitly set attributes) for at least RSpec FactoryBot create/create_list/build plus YAML fixtures and one JS/TS API/factory setup form; other forms abstain naming the side and line.
Differences in kinds, counts and explicitly set attributes are reported, ordered by whether an asserted value reads them; an N vs M child-count difference reports both counts and the asserting lines.
An explicit attribute on one side left at its default on the other is reported; a group-aggregate assertion (total/all/sum across a group) with a single-member seed is reported on both sides.

Incomplete extraction is advisory and names which side was not analysed; parity is never reported when either side was not analysed; identical normalised shapes give no finding (each pinned by a fixture test).
Requirements in test-source-analysis-v0.md using TSA-V0-100..109 only, with traceability; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; Closes #1167.
body: GitHub #1167. When a new test claims to preserve a legacy test's behaviour, test-validity compares assertions but not preconditions: a migrated test can seed a different world (child counts, association shapes, explicitly set vs defaulted attributes, single-member groups behind aggregate claims) and still pass, overstating parity. Link source: the existing legacy crosswalk (documentation-corpus-v1, internal/doccorpus/behavior_legacy_crosswalk.go) or an explicit new>legacy reference. Requested: an advisory-capable SEED-PARITY-DIVERGES check over normalised setup (entity kinds, counts per kind, explicitly set attributes).
title: GH #1167: test-validity: compare a new test's setup against its linked legacy test's fixture (SEED-PARITY-DIVERGES)
